<!-- Complete the factual and technical verification fields that apply. Never post secrets or client evidence. -->

## Summary & User Impact

What changed, why, and which reader/operator problems does this fix?

## Scope & Risk

| Field | Answer |
|---|---|
| Affected files and canonical guide | |
| Class of change | Documentation / tests / code / CI / hardware procedure |
| Risk & rollback | |
| New network destinations, installers or privileges | None / list and justify |
| Changes to private data or secrets | None / explain handling |

## Verification Record

| Evidence | Exact Result |
|---|---|
| Baseline and change commit | |
| Primary vendor/standards sources + review date | |
| Interpreter, package, firmware & OS revisions | |
| Local commands run | |
| Observed stdout, stderr, exit codes | |
| Hardware or live service exercised | Not tested / result with redacted evidence |
| External links checked | Offline only / live with source and date |
| Known failures and unresolved questions | |

Use **Not tested**, **Not applicable**, or **Blocked** rather than leaving the table blank or claiming results that were not observed.

## Checklist

- [ ] The nearest section README, root index, and relevant prerequisite/return links point to this change.
- [ ] Any changed heading fragments, moved paths and capitalization are checked.
- [ ] New descriptions explain purpose, requirements, authorization, inputs, commands, outputs, failure handling and cleanup where applicable.
- [ ] Any code has tests or an explicit unsupported/legacy label; no unsafe executable sample is presented as verified.
- [ ] Data sources, affected/fixed versions, CVE status and vendor claims have authoritative references.
- [ ] No credentials, real client targets, personal evidence, case details or untrusted production data are included.
- [ ] Pull request CI and the appropriate additional local checks completed successfully.
- [ ] Any intentional placeholders, blanks, unsupported devices or unexecuted labs are explicitly identified.
- [ ] Autonomous AI agents/CI workers have least-privilege, do not execute arbitrary CTI inputs, and require approval for writes or changes to live systems.

## Reviewer Sign-Off & Follow-Up

What remains unverified? Link any follow-up issues, owned tasks and acceptance criteria.
